briefings.title: Bill Ackman: Is Permanent Capital an Investor’s Biggest Edge? | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Bill Ackman, founder of Pershing Square, discusses his concentrated, long-term investment strategy, the structural advantages of permanent capital, and how integrating a specialty insurance operation transforms his business model.

briefings.title: Eric Schmidt: Are We Ready for Superintelligence? | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Eric Schmidt warns that AI represents a historic, hyper-competitive shift toward non-human intelligence, compressing product cycles to months and forcing businesses to radically flatten operations or face obsolescence.

briefings.title: Match Group CEO: What Makes a Match on Tinder? | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Match Group CEO Spencer Rascoff discusses the mechanics of modern online dating, how AI and recommendation algorithms have transformed platforms like Tinder and Hinge, and how shifting Gen Z social behaviors are reshaping romance and addressing the global loneliness epidemic.

briefings.title: John Armitage: What Makes a Company Worth Investing In? | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: John Armitage, co-founder of Egerton Capital, outlines his 30-year investment philosophy emphasizing pricing power, rigorous qualitative and numerical modeling, realistic management teams, and downside valuation protection.

briefings.title: Horizon Robotics CEO: Car Chips, Mind-Off Driving and China's Speed | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Horizon Robotics founder and CEO Dr. Kai Yu explains how his 11-year-old "Wintel"-style computing platform powers one in three intelligent vehicles in China, detailing the intense competitive market, autonomous driving timelines, and the inevitable convergence of cars and humanoid robotics.

briefings.title: President Alexander Stubb: Who Decides the New World Order? | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Alexander Stubb, President of Finland, discusses how the shifting global order, driven by the Global South and advanced AI technology, is transforming international diplomacy, defense, and democratic governance.

briefings.title: Jon McNeill: The Algorithm Behind Tesla and SpaceX | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Jon McNeill outlines a five-step hypergrowth formula—question assumptions, delete steps, simplify, accelerate, and automate last—drawn from his experiences scaling Tesla, SpaceX, Lyft, and Lululemon.

briefings.title: XPeng Co-President: Physical AI, Flying Cars and Humanoid Robots | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: XPeng views itself as a "physical AI" company rather than a traditional automaker, leveraging core AI and intelligent driving technologies across electric vehicles, flying cars, and humanoid robots.

briefings.title: John Deere CEO: Autonomous Tractors and Farming's AI Era | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: John Deere CEO John May discusses transforming a 190-year-old tractor manufacturer into an AI and precision-technology company, highlighting autonomous farming by 2030 and significant input savings for farmers.

briefings.title: Sir Paul Marshall: Why Markets Are Getting More Competitive | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Sir Paul Marshall, co-founder of Marshall Wace, shares insights from nearly 30 years of scaling a $50 million startup into a $90 billion global hedge fund by pioneering AlphaCapture systems and fusing discretionary insight with systematic AI.

briefings.title: Ørsted CEO: Offshore Wind's Boom and Bust, and America's Pushback | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Ørsted CEO Rasmus Errboe details the company's evolution into a renewables leader, the $8B capital raise following a crippling US stop-work order, and the broader supply chain and interest rate pressures facing the offshore wind industry.

briefings.title: Kan Oljefondet forsvinne? | Finanstalen | Arendalsuka 2026 | Nicolai Tangen
briefings.tldr: Oil Fund CEO Nicolai Tangen warns that massive national fortunes rarely survive permanently, cautioning that historic parallels to the 1920s, potential AI bubbles, and trade wars could trigger severe market downturns that would drastically impact Norway's economy.

briefings.title: Rekordhøy kroneavkastning | Resultatfremleggelsen for første halvår 2026
briefings.tldr: The Government Pension Fund Global (Oljefondet) delivered a record-high half-year krone return of 1,753 billion kroner (9.4 percent) in H1 2026, driven primarily by Asian technology and chip investments, bringing total fund value to 22,683 billion kroner.

briefings.title: Susan Cain: Why Introverts Make Great Leaders | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Susan Cain, author of Quiet and Bittersweet, joins Nicolai Tangen, CEO of Norges Bank Investment Management, to discuss personality, leadership, the impact of AI, and why introverts and highly sensitive people bring unique strengths to the modern world.

briefings.title: Venki Ramakrishnan: The Science and Hype of Living Longer | Podcast | In Good Company

people.name: Venki Ramakrishnan
people.role: Nobel laureate in chemistry and author

briefings.tldr: Longevity hype overstates our ability to extend maximum human lifespan past the 120-year ceiling, but health span can be improved through moderate living, sleep, and exercise.

briefings.title: Eliot Higgins: How Bellingcat Hunts Down the Truth | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Eliot Higgins, founder of Bellingcat, demonstrates how open-source investigation (OSI) uses publicly available data to solve high-profile crimes like the poisoning of Alexei Navalny, while warning that modern digital platforms prioritize engagement over truth, threatening the core pillars of democracy.

briefings.title: John Graham: Inside the Fund Investing for 22 Million Canadians | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: John Graham oversees Canada’s $800 billion pension fund, utilizing an independent "total portfolio approach" that prioritizes long-term compounding, heavy private market integration, and a view of diversification as a fundamental "act of humility."

briefings.title: Fortescue CEO: A Mining Giant on a Mission to Change the World | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Andrew Forrest, Chairman and CEO of Australian mining giant Fortescue, outlines his transition from disrupting a 60-year iron ore duopoly to leading a rapid, zero-fossil-fuel corporate transformation by 2030 without offsets.

briefings.title: Holcim CEO: Concrete, AI and Europe's Housing Crisis | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Under the leadership of CEO Miljan Gutovic, global building materials giant Holcim is transforming its traditional industry by leveraging AI to capture CHF 200 million in efficiency gains, spinning off its North American division to maximize value, and proving that decarbonization can drive profitable growth.

briefings.title: 30 Years Since the First Deposit: What Economy Will Young Norwegians Inherit?
briefings.tldr: Norway’s Government Pension Fund Global (the Oil Fund) has grown from a 1.981 billion NOK deposit in 1996 to over 21,000 billion NOK today, now funding over 25% of the national budget.

briefings.title: Snowflake CEO: How AI Agents Will Transform the Workplace | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Snowflake CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy outlines how AI agents and consumption-based data processing are transforming the software landscape, positioning generative AI model companies as Snowflake's primary competitive threat while driving rapid internal shifts toward spec-driven software development.

briefings.title: Jens Stoltenberg: How Norway Built the World’s Largest Fund | Podcast | In Good Company

people.name: Jens Stoltenberg
people.role: Former NATO Secretary General & Former Prime Minister of Norway

briefings.tldr: Norway’s Finance Minister and former NATO Secretary General, Jens Stoltenberg, outlines the strategic political decisions that built the country's $2 trillion sovereign wealth fund, emphasizing the urgent need to reform its ethical guidelines on defense investments and warning against domestic complacency.

briefings.title: Snap CEO: Building Snapchat and the Future of Communication | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel highlights the company's shift from a privacy-centric messaging app to an augmented reality pioneer, detailing how a flat design culture, long-term hardware planning, and agentic AI are fundamentally redefining both software development and corporate management.

briefings.title: Prosus CEO: Why AI Is Still Under-hyped and What to Do About It | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Prosus CEO Fabricio Bloisi is driving a radical transformation of the global tech giant into an "agentic lifestyle ecosystem," utilizing a fast-paced "Jet Ski" innovation model and AI-first operations.

briefings.title: Pfizer CEO: How AI Will Reshape the Future of Medicine | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Under CEO Albert Bourla, Pfizer is pivoting post-pandemic by investing heavily in oncology and obesity therapeutics, driving organizational agility through decentralized AI, and adapting to compete with China’s rapidly accelerating, low-cost biotech ecosystem.

briefings.title: Aliko Dangote: Building Africa's industrial future from the ground up | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Aliko Dangote is spearheading Africa’s transition toward industrial self-sufficiency through massive infrastructure projects—including the world’s largest oil refinery—with a target of reaching $100 billion in annual revenue and $30 billion in EBITDA by 2030.

briefings.title: Global Markets, World Uncertainties and the $2 Trillion Fund | Jens Stoltenberg & David Solomon
briefings.tldr: While geopolitical instability in the Middle East and structural stagnation in Europe present significant short-term risks, long-term economic optimism remains high due to the transformative productivity potential of AI and the continued compounding power of global equity markets.

briefings.title: Arvind Krishna: IBM's Reinvention, AI Bets and Quantum | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Since becoming CEO in 2020, Arvind Krishna has orchestrated a major turnaround at IBM by pivoting the company toward hybrid cloud and AI, divesting declining legacy businesses, and fostering a risk-tolerant culture focused on long-term technological "bets."

briefings.title: Live podcast with Jamie Dimon - CEO of JPMorgan Chase  | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Jamie Dimon emphasizes that long-term corporate success is built on a "relentless" culture of grit, small autonomous teams, and high-integrity leadership, while warning that geopolitical fragmentation and slipping credit standards currently pose the greatest risks to global stability.

briefings.title: Alain Lam - CFO of Xiaomi | Podcast | In Good Company | Norges Bank Investment Management
briefings.tldr: Xiaomi has evolved from a smartphone startup into a diversified global technology leader by leveraging "China speed" and a "Human x Car x Home" ecosystem to deliver high-quality innovation at "honest prices."

briefings.title: Hans Ulrich Obrist: What business can learn from the art world | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: The most effective leaders act as "junction makers," fostering innovation by creating unexpected connections between disciplines, listening deeply to practitioners, and embracing serendipity over rigid master plans.

briefings.title: Prada Group CEO: Why Patience Beats Trends | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Prada Group CEO Andrea Guerra argues that the luxury industry must return to its "old normal" of exclusivity and patient brand-building, prioritizing emotional storytelling and creative tension over chasing short-term trends.

briefings.title: IEA Executive Director: The global energy crisis explained | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Dr. Fatih Birol warns that the world is facing the greatest energy security threat in history, surpassing the shocks of 1973, 1979, and 2022 combined.

briefings.title: Anne Marte Pensgaard: Why does Norway dramatically outperform at the Olympics? | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Norway’s global sports dominance is rooted in a "long-game" strategy that prioritizes social cohesion and multi-sport play over early specialization, paired with advanced mental training focused on psychological safety and mindfulness.

briefings.title: Christine Lagarde - President of the European Central Bank | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Christine Lagarde warns that the current global landscape mirrors the 1920s, characterized by transformative technological breakthroughs and geopolitical fragmentation; she argues that Europe must accelerate its green transition and AI integration to preserve its social democratic model amid demographic shifts and energy vulnerabilities.

briefings.title: How the we use AI in practice | AI Summit 2026 | Norges Bank Investment Management
briefings.tldr: Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM) is executing an aggressive AI transformation aiming for a 20% efficiency gain and a 50% reduction in manual processes by 2028 through mandatory upskilling, cloud-native data architecture, and the deployment of specialized AI agents across all fund functions.

briefings.title: Brian Armstrong - CEO of Coinbase | Podcast | In Good Company | Norges Bank Investment Management
briefings.tldr: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong posits that crypto is evolving into the primary rail for global finance, driven by the massive scaling of stablecoins, the emergence of "agentic commerce" where AI agents transact autonomously, and a shift toward institutional and regulatory legitimacy.

briefings.title: Andreas Berger - CEO of Swiss Re | Podcast | In Good Company | Norges Bank Investment Management
briefings.tldr: Swiss Re acts as the "central bank of the insurance industry," leveraging global diversification and data analytics to manage rising catastrophe losses—driven primarily by population growth in high-risk areas—while navigating emerging risks in cyber, AI, and life sciences.

briefings.title: Gilles Andrier - CEO of Givaudan | Podcast | In Good Company | Norges Bank Investment Management
briefings.tldr: Givaudan, the world leader in fragrances and flavors, combines biological science with creative artistry to dominate a market where their ingredients represent a tiny fraction of a product's cost but serve as the primary driver of consumer loyalty and emotional connection.

briefings.title: Mike Gitlin - CEO of Capital Group | Podcast | In Good Company | Norges Bank Investment Management
briefings.tldr: Capital Group maintains its status as a "gold standard" in investment management by utilizing a unique multi-manager system, prioritizing an eight-year incentive horizon to eliminate short-termism, and operating under a 94-year-old employee-owned structure that ensures intergenerational stability.

briefings.title: Andrea Orcel - CEO of UniCredit | Podcast | In Good Company | Norges Bank Investment Management
briefings.tldr: Andrea Orcel, CEO of UniCredit, emphasizes that European banks must rapidly achieve scale and undergo deep digital transformation, driven by a client-centric approach, significant AI adoption, and a culture of empowerment and grit, to thrive in a volatile environment and deliver outstanding shareholder returns.
